subject: Sprint-to-QBR constraints alignment & dependency requests
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Heather Long <heather.long@olivetech.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sprint-to-QBR constraints alignment & dependency requests

Team — attaching an action grid and an updated dependency map as we push into the QBR week. High-level status for the mid-quarter check-in:

- OKR: Reduce inference unit cost by 18% vs baseline — currently at 11% (on track but behind plan on quantization rollout).
- Customer-facing reliability OKR — saw two P2s this sprint; mitigation work ongoing.
- Feature sprint (dynamic KV cache) is ~40% complete; needs low-latency infra changes to ship on schedule.

Immediate asks:
1) Infrastructure: need a firm commit on 4 additional GPU nodes for a 72-hour window the week of Oct 11 to run end-to-end perf validation. Owner: Mina.
2) Platform: markus, we need a trimmed rollout plan for quantized model variants (fast/cheap fallback) — scope suggested in the attachment.
3) Customer comms: Vanessa, please confirm whether Olive Tech needs a demo window before the Oct 18 QBR; Heather is cc'd.

Attachments: [Attachment: QBR_prep_action_grid.xlsx (19KB)], [Attachment: dependency_map-v2.png (320KB)]

Proposed next steps: please reply with "commit/soft-commit/no" next to each ask by end of day Monday so I can fold into the QBR readout. If you need to escalate to execs for capacity, call it out explicitly.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Product Operations, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

---
Note: Heather — thanks for the quick sync yesterday. If Olive Tech wants a pre-QBR demo we can prioritize a condensed perf run, but it will depend on infra availability above.

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprint-to-QBR constraints alignment & dependency requests

Stephanie — thanks for the concise layscape. Quick responses inline: 

1) Quantization rollout: soft-commit. I can scope a two-track rollout: (A) internal canary to validate quality degradation on existing prompts (2 days), (B) phased customer rollout (week-of Oct 18). I'll share the trimmed plan by Monday EOD.

2) Low-latency infra changes: the extra GPU nodes are feasible but not guaranteed. Mina, I need you to confirm whether we can schedule the 72-hour window Oct 11–14. If we can't allocate on that window I'd like a fallback: scoped perf validation on reduced token budgets (we know cost/latency tradeoffs).

3) I flagged the action grid with two items where we need to accept scope reductions to hit QBR metrics — linking to the red cells in the sheet.

Attachment referenced: none (using Stephanie's grid).

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Platform Engineering, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 27 Sep 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprint-to-QBR constraints alignment & dependency requests

Quick note from product — suggested re-scope and customer-facing commitments: 

- Proposal: move non-critical perf telemetry embargo (OKR subtask) to post-QBR; reclaim that dev effort for the quantization canary and KV cache integration. This preserves the reliability fixes + keeps us on track for the headline 18% target.
- If infra cannot support the full 72-hour run, request is to run two shorter windowed validations (24h + 24h) targeted at worst-case prompts; that will validate regressions and unblock the demo.

Vanessa — if Olive Tech expects a full-feature demo, call that out now. Otherwise we can present a condensed metrics readout plus a separate sequence for a hands-on demo after we finish the perf validation.

I can own rewording the QBR slide that shows the shifted scope — will send a PR for the deck on Monday.

Laura Bennett
Director, Product Management, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprint-to-QBR constraints alignment & dependency requests

All — confirmed infra availability and constraints.

- Commit: We can allocate 3 GPU nodes for a focused 48-hour perf window between Oct 12–14 (firm). I cannot commit 4 nodes for 72 hours due to an overlapping partner test (region us-west).
- Mitigation: I'll schedule the partner test to run on staging only and give you a prioritized list of workloads to run during the 48h window. If you accept that scope, we will be able to produce the perf matrix needed for the QBR.
- Fallback: If product needs a full 72h, we can run the additional validation on batch night runs (reduced QoS) but that will not be demo-ready for Oct 18.

I updated the dependency_map-v2 (see attachment) with the exact node window and the staging limitations.

Action items:
- Stephanie: call in the exec for an exception if you want the full 72h with 4 nodes (I will support escalation).
- Markus: please prioritize the canary test cases list so Mina's team has an ordered runbook.
- Laura/Vanessa: decide whether to present condensed readout on Oct 18 + schedule hands-on demo after additional validation.

Attachments: [Attachment: dependency_map-v2.png (320KB)]

Mina Haddad
Senior Engineering Manager, Infra & Reliability, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
